answer_1.quote: We evaluate the benefit of the augmented dialogue data in both retrieval-based and generation-based dialogue models... generation-based models, which decode responses from a learned distribution.
answer_1.outputs: augmented post-response pairs and generated dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation of augmented dialogue pairs uses the following metrics: 1) Distinct ... 2) Novelty ... The retrieval-based dialogue models are evaluated using MAP and R10@k. The generation-based dialogue models are evaluated using Perplexity, BLEU, and Distinct.

answer_4.quote: Three annotators are employed to rate these pairs from two aspects: 1) Fluency (Flu.) ... 2) Coherency (Coh.) ... The rating scale for each measure is of (0, 1, 2) ... Manual evaluation is also performed for the generated dialogue responses following the same protocol.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate Fluency and Coherency on a 0‑2 scale for each dialogue pair/response.
